events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
Hi, this is Maria Alvarez. March 14th, 1968. I need a refill of my inhaler.
One moment while I check your details.
I found two inhalers on your record: albuterol inhaler, two puffs every four to six hours when needed, and budesonide inhaler, one puff twice a day. Which one would you like me to request?
The blue one, the albuterol . And that's a yes to the request. So go ahead and send it .
Let me look at your record.
Your request reference is R Q, two zero zero six. It is awaiting prescribing team review, and they will call or text you with the outcome.
That request has already been recorded as R Q, two zero zero six. It is awaiting prescribing team review.
